acts.desc: Fans of movie musicals might know about something called the "I Wish" number. In many movies and Broadway shows, it's the main character's first song, in which they express the hope that will set the story in motion. Host Ira Glass explains it, and plays a few examples.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Contributor Starlee Kine tells a story about getting as close to one promised land—Disneyland—as you possibly can, without actually going in.
acts.title: Across the Street From Heaven

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: For millennia, people have tried to reach a spiritual promised land by fasting. Jesus did it. Buddha did it. Monks and saints and new age gurus have done it. And, for for this episode, David Rakoff tried it. He did a 20-day fast, to find out if it would bring him any form of enlightenment. David died in 2012, eight years after reporting this story. We devoted an episode to him and his stories.
acts.title: Life In The Fast Lane

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Hillary Frank with a story of a train ride, an overheard conversation, and two people seeking two different promised lands.
acts.title: Mystery Train
